name: codebreakers-online
description: Definitive edition of a block-based fighting game, then a browser port with rollback netplay.

scripts.unpack: unzip -o -q "Codebreakers 1.5.1 - SSS2(1).sb3" -d work/cb && unzip -o -q "Project K 1.3.1.sb3" -d work/pk
scripts.assets:menu: node tools/stage-thumbs.cjs && node tools/classic-cards.cjs && node tools/daily-row.cjs
scripts.build:sb3: npm run merge && npm run validate && npm run check && npm run pack
scripts.test:asm: node tools/merge/asm-test.cjs work/cb && node tools/merge/asm-test.cjs work/pk
